current_events: The Wall Street Journal reports that United States president Donald Trump has rejected Iranian foreign minister Abbas Araghchi's proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and halt regional fighting within seven days in exchange for easing U.S. sanctions and releasing Iranian frozen funds
2026 Iran war ceasefire, 2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis
Russian drone and missile strikes on residential buildings and other civilian sites in Kyiv, Ukraine, kill seven people, including a 14-year-old boy, and injure 46 others
Kyiv strikes, Russian attacks on civilians in the Russo-Ukrainian war

The Puntland Maritime Police Force successfully frees the oil tanker Sibu 1 following a multi-day counter-piracy operation near Garacad, Mudug, Puntland, after it was seized by Somali pirates in August
Piracy off the coast of Somalia
Pakistan says that its military has killed 13 Afghan security forces during shootouts at the border. Afghanistan's government denies the claim

Brazilian president Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signs an executive order banning online betting in Brazil, immediately halting new deposits. Users may withdraw remaining funds until October 5, and Congress must approve the measure within 120 days for it to remain in force
A military aircraft carrying 13 people, including three officers, crashes near Kenge, Kwango, Democratic Republic of the Congo, while on route to Kinshasa, killing all passengers
Six people are missing and two others are found injured after a suspected gas leak causes an explosion and collapses a two-storey building in Plaka, Athens, Greece
Two people are killed and 13 more injured in a fire at a residential building in Lucca, Tuscany, Italy
Mary Jane Veloso is released from a prison in Mandaluyong, Philippines, after president Bongbong Marcos's absolute pardon of her was approved yesterday
Mary Jane Veloso drug smuggling case

In swimming, China's Zhang Zhanshuo becomes the first athlete to win seven gold medals at a single Asian Games, securing his seventh title in the men's 400-metre freestyle with a Games-record time of 3:41.28
China at the 2026 Asian Games, Swimming at the 2026 Asian Games
In association football, an independent Premier League commission finds Manchester City F.C. guilty of 114 of 115 alleged financial-rule breaches spanning the 2009–10 to 2022–23 seasons
